title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Tiffany Lieu is a Lecturer on Law and Clinical Instructor in the Crimmigration Clinic at Harvard Law School. At the clinic, she supervises and trains law students on appellate and affirmative litigation and policy advocacy on a range of issues at the intersection of criminal and immigration law, including criminal bars to immigration relief, crime-based […]
